name: dungeon-gate-shop
about: Dungeon: open the extract gate by interacting, then the ghost shop panel by calling its open method (shops spawn only on some floors; a null spot shows the empty stock), shoot each, close with B. Template for dungeon-only panels. The world behind the panels animates (a bat at top right differs per run), so baseline diffs ignore the `mask` rectangle and any change under `tol` (torch flicker).
